summary: Router 0.42.16 implements TM-04's per-client model allowlist as kay asked (ADR-0140, proposed, supersedes ADR-0052 whose status becomes 'superseded by ADR-0140'). client_auth.clients.<c>.models: true | false | list of concrete names. One parser, values.model_grant (bool as is; list of at most 200 names matching [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:/@+-]{0,199}, trimmed, deduplicated, empty = false; anything else a Problem naming the key) used by config.py, settings.coerce (new type modelgrant: '*' = true, '' = false, comma list) and admin._client_spec (UI API client creation; before it did bool(value), so 'yes' meant true - now refused). values.model_granted normalises a missing tag to :latest on both sides (Ollama's resolution; scheduler.known_concrete returns the tagged name). Traced B1: both proxy call sites call auth.client_allows(request, role, concrete=True) with the concrete role whose name is the resolved model; client_grant now checks that name against the grant (true, the internal UI client, or listed); the refusal text names the model and the allowlist, counting and audit unchanged. Listings: tags_list checks each concrete name (so /v1/models/{model} 404s for an unlisted one), handle_ps checks each loaded model (listed -> with model and node; unlisted but its role granted -> role entry without model/node; else hidden). Observe without identity and the internal client unchanged. B2: the UI renders the grant as text via data-change/setChange with the existing 'text' conversion (no inline handler, CSP unchanged); the server validates every value. A listed name no node offers is accepted (documented); no patterns (deliberately).

tests.evidence: 6 tests: parser (true/false/list, trim, dedupe, empty=false; refuses 'yes', 1, None, bad names, '' entry, numbers, 201 names, a dict - key named); tag normalisation; settings.coerce and admin._client_spec use it ('*', '', comma list; 'yes' refused); configuration list accepted, 'yes' refused; request path: listed model allowed, unlisted refused with the allowlist reason and audited (rejected case), roles-only refused, UI client and unidentified unchanged; /api/tags, /v1/models and /api/ps show only the listed concrete model. With the six changed modules from origin/main: 4 failures, 8 errors.

tests.command: python test/selftest_security.py; python test/selftest_model_listing.py; python test/selftest_browser.py
tests.evidence: ADR-0052's cases (missing setting, true, non-boolean string), the ADR-0131/0133 listing tests and the UI's no-inline-handler/CSP checks unchanged.

Client fields show '*' for models true and empty for false (type text, placeholder 'keine'); typing 'granite4.2:8b, qwen3-coder:30b' for a client and saving through the UI's own change action stored the list (overridden, value as list); no CSP violation; with that client's token /api/tags listed only granite4.2:8b among concrete names and /api/chat for it passed the grant check (503 only for the unavailable test node).

tests.command: every python test/... and tools/... command of all workflows in .github/workflows/, except run_tests.py and check_public_changes; plus ruff check ., router.py --check router/config.example.yaml --pure and node --check router/ui.js

tests.evidence: run after staging this record; synthetic model names only.

limitations: Exact names only, no patterns; a name no node offers yet is accepted and grants nothing until it appears.
/api/show answers model details for any name a client asks about, as before.
